features:
Gohan Hub is an all-in-one progression, autofarm and character utility hub designed to make progression significantly faster.

Features:

* Advanced NPC Autofarm — automatically farm selected NPCs with configurable positioning and farming options
* Train While Autofarming — train your stats at the same time as you autofarm NPCs, allowing you to progress in two areas simultaneously and effectively speed up progression
* Enhanced Build Planner — choose your desired enhanced stat targets and priority order, then automatically allocate GTP toward completing your build
* Unlock All Forms
* Unlock Race Forms
* Set Race + Trait
* Unlock All Skill Tree
* Unlock Ki
* Unlock Flight
* Auto Transform — automatically use your selected transformation while farming
* Auto Food — automatically manage hunger and purchase more food when needed
* Remote Shop — purchase supported items and food remotely
* Player ESP — view useful information about other players
* Teleport Menu — quickly travel between supported locations
* Doctor — view detailed character and injury information directly through the hub
* Live Character Stats
* Fast Flight
* Noclip / Camera Clip
* Server Hop & Server Utilities
* Config System — save and automatically load your preferred settings

Includes free and premium features, with Premium giving access to some of Gohan Hub's most powerful progression and character tools.
